entries.subject: For Victor de la Serna: Habeeb / Monegros 2027
entries.action: Send the draft this week to the published festival inbox, requesting routing to Victor de la Serna. Ask whether House / Tech House programming is taking proposals before discussing fees.
entries.fit: Strongest new stylistic match. General routing address, not Victor's personal inbox; a large international festival remains a competitive booking.
entries.body:
Hi Victor,

I'm Joanna Biehler at Night Method Agency, representing Habeeb. I'm reaching out about House / Tech House consideration for Monegros 2027.

Your archive includes Joseph Capriati and Seth Troxler, which gives me a specific reason to approach the house side of the programme. Habeeb works from a House / Tech House foundation with an experimental edge, treating his sets as dynamic performances. I'd like you to hear his work before deciding whether there's a place for him in your plans.

He played Breakaway Dallas 2026 and Green Light Social / Sunset Sessions in Dallas, and has an Animarum label showcase in Berlin scheduled for spring 2027. We can discuss availability and travel separately from that engagement.

Music and background: [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider him for the 2027 programme? If this reaches the general team, please forward it to Victor or Monegros music programming.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency

entries.subject: For Tom Carpenter: Habeeb for Gottwood 2027
entries.action: Ask the general festival team to route the draft to Tom Carpenter / programming. Confirm 10-13 June availability and whether an emerging overseas artist fits the 2027 programme.
entries.fit: House and UK club crossover fit, supported by Conducta and Oppidan on the 2026 bill. Boutique curation and travel costs make this selective, not an assumed opening.
entries.body:
Hi Tom,

Conducta and Oppidan on Gottwood's 2026 bill caught my attention because they connect the house floor with the wider UK club sound. I'd like to introduce Habeeb for 2027 through that part of the programme.

I'm Joanna Biehler, his manager at Night Method Agency. He's a House / Tech House artist with an experimental edge, and his sets are dynamic performances. The smaller, distinctly programmed spaces at Gottwood are why I'm approaching you with an artist proposal rather than a general festival introduction.

Habeeb has played Green Light Social / Sunset Sessions in Dallas and opened for James Kennedy, with Benjamin Lloyd support upcoming. For Gottwood, I'd focus the conversation on the music in his EPK and a set suited to your house and garage programming.

You can hear his work here: [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider him for Gottwood 2027? If necessary, please pass this to Tom or the programming team.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency

entries.fit: A stretch target for the experimental house side of the project. Highly selective curation; dates and slots are unconfirmed.
entries.body:
Hi Craig,

I'm writing with an artist introduction for Houghton's 2027 planning. Seeing Peach and Shanti Celeste on the 2026 programme made me think the experimental house side of Habeeb's work could be worth your consideration.

I'm Joanna Biehler at Night Method Agency, and I manage Habeeb. His foundation is House / Tech House, with an experimental edge and an approach to sets as dynamic performances. I'd welcome your view on whether his sound belongs in the programme before we discuss any particular stage or time.

He has played Friends Only and Vice Park. He's also scheduled for an Animarum label showcase in Berlin in spring 2027; any Houghton booking would be planned separately once your dates are confirmed.

Music and artist information: [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider him for 2027? Please route this to Craig or the music programming team if needed.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency

entries.subject: Habeeb for Marvellous Island 2027 / La Kasbah
entries.action: RETAINED: if you have not already sent the earlier draft, write directly to Laurent about the La Kasbah House / Tech House programme. Check availability for 15-16 May first.
entries.fit: Direct published professional email and a named House / Tech House stage. Not a new lead; no new contact claimed.
entries.body:
Hi Laurent,

I'm Joanna Biehler at Night Method Agency, reaching out about Habeeb for Marvellous Island 2027. La Kasbah's House / Tech House focus looks like the most relevant place to start the conversation.

Your 2026 booking of Nic Fanciulli gives me a concrete programming connection for Habeeb's House / Tech House foundation. He brings an experimental edge and treats his sets as dynamic performances. I'd like to put his music in front of you for consideration as you build the next edition.

He played Breakaway Dallas 2026 and has Breakaway Houston upcoming. He has also performed at Green Light Social / Sunset Sessions in Dallas. We are discussing European opportunities for 2027 and would confirm the May dates and travel arrangements with you before any commitment.

His music and background are here: [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider Habeeb for La Kasbah in 2027? I'd be happy to discuss availability and the right set length if the music fits.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency

entries.body:
Hi Simon,

Todd Edwards on Horst's 2026 programme is the connection behind this introduction. I'd like you to hear Habeeb for 2027: a House / Tech House artist with an experimental edge whose sets are dynamic performances.

I'm Joanna Biehler, his manager at Night Method Agency. Horst's interest in artists who contribute something particular to the programme is why I'm approaching you directly, rather than assuming that a festival credit alone establishes the fit. His EPK is the best starting point for that judgment.

Habeeb has played Vice Park and Friends Only, and has an Animarum label showcase in Berlin scheduled for spring 2027. We can discuss a separate Belgium booking and travel plan if the music interests you.

Listen and read more: [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider him for Horst 2027? If this reaches the general team, please forward it to Simon or music programming.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency
